dataset_hash_none_behavior.notes: When dataset_hash is None, cache key omits ds_<hash> suffix. Querying with a hash misses the None-hash entry.

in_memory_polars.mechanism: compute_dataset_fingerprint samples indices [0, n//2, n-1] for in-memory DataFrames; mutations outside boundary sample are not detected.

on_disk_parquet_file.mechanism: File paths hash st_size and st_mtime_ns; any on-disk write updates timestamp and triggers cache miss.
